cohort: Consecutive preterm infants breathing unsupported in room air with a gestational age of 28-34 weeks in a tertiary neonatal intensive care unit, studied before discharge from neonatal care.
finding: In convalescent preterm neonates, the work of breathing (PTPdi) was lower in the prone and supine-tilt positions compared with the supine position, with no significant difference between prone and supine-tilt.
cross-section timing: Before discharge from neonatal care, during convalescence.
